title: Log a call to the patient
summary: Record that the patient was called about an alert: when and what was discussed.

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Log call
steps.details: Tap the alert's phone icon. Do it on the alert you want to work on.

steps.title: Date and time
steps.details: Required: when the call was made. Without a date and time it can't be recorded.

steps.title: Notes
steps.details: What was discussed, whether they answered, whether to call back.

steps.title: Log
steps.details: The alert becomes Action taken and the call stays in its history.
